_comment: Laya's on-device files (docs/BUILD.md A1, risk 2). Host: the owner's Supabase Storage public bucket 'models' (project zqyeihzjpfnvkrprcwam), files under laya/v1/, served with Range, ETag and Last-Modified so a paused or interrupted download resumes. v1 is never overwritten: a re-export uploads under a new path (laya/v2/, …) and changes urlTemplate, sizes and SHA-256s together with the Kotlin pins in LayaModelStore (a test checks the two agree). An empty host means 'Model host not configured': the app then downloads nothing (DEBUG -LoupeNoModelHost simulates it). urlTemplate placeholders: {host} (https only), {variant}, {file}. Sizes and SHA-256s are the exports parity was measured on.
